source.ref: PY03_summit_provider_manual.md Section 9: Claims for in-home services, 9.1
source.quote: Summit requires a verified EVV record for each billed date of service, member and service.

source.ref: PY03_summit_provider_manual.md Section 9: Claims for in-home services, 9.1
source.quote: Bill in 15-minute units of verified time; partial units are not billable, and units above verified time will be denied.

source.ref: PY03_summit_provider_manual.md Section 9: Claims for in-home services, 9.2
source.quote: A Summit authorization number is mandatory on every claim.

source.ref: PY03_summit_provider_manual.md Section 9: Claims for in-home services, 9.2
source.quote: The authorization must be for the member and service billed and cover the date of service.

source.ref: PY03_summit_provider_manual.md Section 9: Claims for in-home services, 9.2
source.quote: Paid units are deducted from the authorization; claims exceeding the balance will be denied.

source.ref: PY03_summit_provider_manual.md Section 9: Claims for in-home services, 9.3
source.quote: Claims must be received within 60 calendar days of the date of service.

source.ref: PY03_summit_provider_manual.md Section 9: Claims for in-home services, 9.4

open_questions.quote: Additional billing requirements may apply under your agency's contract with Summit.
open_questions.question: The handbook refers to contract-specific billing requirements without stating them. A reviewer needs to obtain the agency's contract with Summit to identify any additional requirements (e.g., modifiers, daily maximums, or other contract-specific denials such as D10) before rules can be added.
